summary: Killing or removing the Wizard of Yendor reaches mon.c:m_detach(), where JavaScript lacks the wizard-specific bookkeeping. C decrements the live Wizard count, marks the hero demigod once, and draws rn1(250,50). The selected #wizkill route exposes the death caller; a separate recorded #wizmakemap route confirms the live-removal caller.

source.branch: wizdeadorgone() (812-822) unconditionally decrements svc.context.no_of_wizards; only on the first call before u.uevent.udemigod is set does it set that event flag and assign u.udg_cnt = rn1(250, 50). The function is impure through state writes and the conditional random draw.
source.caller: mon.c:m_detach() (2733-2803), after mon_leaving_level() and mtmp->mhp = 0, invokes wizdeadorgone() whenever mtmp->iswiz, before the due_to_death branch and its relobj()/nemesis/leader effects. mondead() (3080-3177) reaches m_detach(mtmp, mptr, TRUE); mongone() (3267-3283) reaches m_detach(mdef, mdef->data, FALSE). The function therefore handles both death and removal alive.
productionRoutes: Selected death route: wizard-mode #wizgenesis creates the Wizard of Yendor; #wizkill selects it and invokes wizcmds.c:wiz_kill() -> xkilled() -> mondead() -> m_detach() -> wizdeadorgone(). JavaScript command dispatch is cmd.js -> wizcmds.js:wiz_kill() -> mon.js:xkilled() -> mondead() -> m_detach().

Live-removal route requiring independent recorded evidence: #wizgenesis creates the Wizard, then #wizmakemap invokes cmd.c:makemap_prepost(TRUE) -> wizcmds.c:makemap_remove_mons() -> makemap_unmakemon() -> mongone() -> m_detach() -> wizdeadorgone(). The corresponding JS route exists in cmd.js:makemap_prepost() -> wizcmds.js:makemap_remove_mons()/wiz_makemap() -> mon.js:mongone() -> m_detach().
source.javascriptAtBase: js/wizard.js has no wizdeadorgone implementation. js/mon.js:m_detach() currently calls its unsupported handler for iswiz in finishDetach(), which runs after the due-to-death relobj path; this is both missing behavior and the wrong source order. js/mon.js:mongone() has a second obsolete note_unported('end.c wizdeadorgone') shim. Port the C function in js/wizard.js, invoke it at the C source location before death effects, and remove both placeholders.
dependencies: wizdeadorgone() has no C return-value callees. Its conditional rn1(250, 50) draw is provided by the existing JavaScript RNG implementation.
JavaScript command and removal wiring already exists for #wizkill and #wizmakemap; this task only adds the missing wizard bookkeeping and calls it at mon.c:m_detach source order.

The existing wizard.js -> mon.js import cycle must remain safe when mon.js imports the new wizard.js function; preserve synchronous source ordering rather than making the state change an unawaited dynamic import.
callers: mon.c:m_detach() (2733-2803) is the sole direct call site; it calls wizdeadorgone() when mtmp->iswiz after mon_leaving_level() and setting mhp to zero, independent of due_to_death.
mon.c:mondead() (3080-3177) calls m_detach(..., TRUE) for death; mon.c:mongone() (3267-3283) calls m_detach(..., FALSE) for removal while alive.

The selected command route is wizcmds.c:wiz_kill() -> xkilled() -> mondead() -> m_detach(). The second active route is wizcmds.c:wiz_makemap() -> cmd.c:makemap_prepost(TRUE) -> wizcmds.c:makemap_remove_mons() -> makemap_unmakemon() -> mongone() -> m_detach().
